forward_patch:

@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: 8b80
+title: Shard qwen3_5_moe and prism_hadamard_qwen35 (larger-models phase)
+---
+Found in ^csdpw7k. `RemoteModelExecutor.shardableModelFamilies` leaves out `qwen3_5_moe` (its mixture-of-experts layers do not shard) and `prism_hadamard_qwen35` (its rotated projections are not stock projections), so a cluster cannot place either. This is the larger-models phase of the cluster work.
+
+- [ ] Make the MoE layers of `qwen3_5_moe` conform to `TensorParallelShardable` (expert-parallel or per-expert tensor-parallel), with a sharded-vs-local logits test.
+- [ ] Shard the Hadamard-rotated projections of `prism_hadamard_qwen35`, with the same test.
+- [ ] Add both families to `shardableModelFamilies` and its "each shardable model family loads a model that shards" test. #cluster
\ No newline at end of file
